$comment: Third-party skills and where they come from. Content for the 27 skills listed under vendor/sources.json is COMMITTED to this repository under vendor/ and reaches cloud sessions through .claude/skills/. This file records anything NOT vendored, plus the multi-agent install behaviour worth knowing about.

find-skills.reason: Present in ~/.agents/skills but NOT linked into ~/.claude/skills, so it is not available to Claude Code locally either. Vendoring it would add a capability rather than port one. Add it to vendor/sources.json if that changes.

ui-ux-pro-max.reason: A real directory in ~/.claude/skills duplicating what the ui-ux-pro-max plugin already ships. The plugin is declared in .claude/settings.json and installs in cloud, so the skill arrives that way. Vendoring it would fork a plugin's own content for no gain.

ecc skills (181).reason: Delivered by the ecc plugin, declared in .claude/settings.json.

multiAgentFanOut.$comment: The skills CLI installs into every detected agent directory, not just Claude Code. Recorded because a reinstall reproduces this fan-out and it explains why identical content exists in seven trees on this machine.
multiAgentFanOut.lockFileNote: Records source and a folder hash but NO commit pin, which is why vendor/sources.json resolves pins independently.
